name: folio-media
description: Regenerates Folio's icons, social card and README screenshots/GIFs from the running app.

scripts.stills: node capture.js stills memory hero mobile && THEME=dark node capture.js stills memory hero mobile && python3 phones.py && python3 optimize.py
scripts.gifs: node capture.js gifs libraryopen && THEME=dark node capture.js swipe open read quiz libraryopen
scripts.memory: node capture.js memory && THEME=dark node capture.js memory
scripts.libraryopen: node capture.js libraryopen && THEME=dark node capture.js libraryopen
scripts.all: npm run icons && npm run stills && npm run gifs && npm run library
